source.citation: Kim H, Park SS, Choi S, et al. Population Pharmacokinetics and Model-Informed Precision Dosing of Lenalidomide Incorporating Total and Unbound Plasma Concentrations in Renally Impaired Patients with Multiple Myeloma. Drug Des Devel Ther. 2026;20:605741.
locations: Results p.8-10 including final-model equations p.10
source.supplementary_material: not obtained; no control stream available
source.review_depth: Main text, tables and printed equations; equations read from the rendered page image.

structure.concentration_scale: Parameters describe UNBOUND drug (apparent unbound CL/F, V1/F, Q/F, V2/F). Total concentration = unbound concentration / Fu (linear binding).
structure.protein_binding: linear; Fu constant, no covariates (p.10, Discussion p.16)
structure.location: Results p.8; equations p.10; protein-binding equation p.5

random_effects.distribution: exponential (log-normal), estimated for CL/F and V1/F only (Results p.8)
random_effects.cv_to_omega: ASSUMPTION: omega = %CV/100 (the convention confirmed for Hughes; not confirmed here because no control stream is available)

residual_error.location: Table 3 ("addictive" in the source is a typo for additive)

study_population.design: prospective; serial sampling at steady state on day 3 of cycle 1 at 0, 2, 4, 8, 12 and 24 h; fasting 10 h before and 4 h after dose
study_population.location: Table 1 p.7 (serum creatinine unit printed as g/dL; mg/dL intended)

transcription_notes: Printed CL/F equation places the BSA term outside the exponential (additive in L/h). The paper's own target-attainment results are reproduced only by a multiplicative form; see kim_cl_equation_form_assessment_v1.json.
Table 3 labels CL/F, V1/F, Q/F and V2/F as apparent UNBOUND parameters; total CL/F = unbound CL/F x Fu (8.52 x 0.614 = 5.23 L/h at the reference covariates).
eGFR is the indexed CKD-EPI 2021 value; the authors also tried non-indexed eGFR and CrCl and found eGFR + BSA fitted best (p.9-10, p.16).
No patient had albumin below 3 g/dL; Fu may not apply to profound hypoalbuminemia (Discussion p.16).
No dialysis or renal replacement therapy patients were included.
The page-10 equation prints V2/F = 21.1 L; Table 3 reports 21.2 L. The Table 3 value is used.

author_reported_groups.use: Internal reproduction only: these are the same patients the model was fitted to.
author_reported_groups.location: Table 1 p.7 (medians); Table 2 p.9 (non-compartmental CL/F, mean +/- SD)
author_reported_groups.caveat: Non-compartmental group means and model typical values at group medians are different statistics; agreement is descriptive.
